integrity: The proof derives all ordinary derivations, reduces locality to a necessary-and-sufficient evaluation-span condition, applies the isotropic/nonsplit dichotomy, proves linear two-local rigidity by two witness pairs, and directly exhibits a separable scalar-extension failure. Symbolic and finite-field checks are reproducibility evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional associative algebras with nondegenerate symmetric binary multiplication form and a one-dimensional annihilator only.
Characteristic two is excluded, and the parameter d is nonzero.
Counts of two-local derivations concern linear maps; nonlinear two-local derivations exist but are not counted.
The split complex local-derivation dimension was known in the originating paper; novelty concerns arbitrary fields and nonsplit Witt type.
The later journal version was compared by abstract and preview rather than its complete interior.
title: Witt-type jumps in local derivations of three-dimensional nilpotent associative algebras
